name: Shandong Golden Empire Precision Machinery Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Golden Empire Precision Machinery Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of precision mechanical components in China and internationally. The company offers bearing cages and bearing accessories; general motor parts, such as transmission system, engine system, seat system, steering system, parking system, and car door components; electric control system, battery system, and asynchronous and synchronous electric driving system motors; and hydrogen energy applications, hydrogen production field, and energy storage field products.
